en.summary: I design and build end-to-end web products — from system and database architecture to polished frontend experiences and production APIs.

career.description: Developing web platforms with Angular, React and Next.js; building REST APIs with Node.js, Express and NestJS; designing systems and databases; and setting up CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
Delivered tailored websites, backend REST APIs with Node.js and Express, and frontend experiences with Vue.js and Nuxt.
Built web applications with Yii, PHP OOP, HTML, CSS, SCSS, jQuery and JavaScript.
